title: Analytics command options
responsibility: Adds the shared analytics attribution options to an existing Commander command.

inputs.name: analyticsOptions.command
inputs.description: The Commander command whose option chain receives the five analytics attribution options. It must be a Commander Command; this function does not parse arguments or assign option defaults.

outputs.name: analyticsOptions
outputs.description: The Command returned by the final .option() call after --loop <name>, --step <id>, --task <id>, --agent-model <name>, and --report <id> are registered. These options are declared with .option() and no defaults, and this function does not parse their values.
